capabilities: Create and renumber chapters and volume folders from file menus
Browse and preview lore and outline notes in a sidebar
Apply first-line indent, line height, fonts, and grid lines to novel files
Count words per file and folder with CJK-aware rules
Export notes as Markdown-free plain text to clipboard or txt file
disambiguation: Not an AI writing helper; it only provides structure, navigation, and formatting tools for novel projects.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it is desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or higher. README is available in English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure or tooling for long-form fiction, so novelists must manually manage chapters, volumes, lore references, and reading layout.
summary: Novel-writing toolkit that organizes lore and outline notes in a sidebar and manages chapter structure, typesetting, word counts, and plain-text export.
